levels.name: Leech
levels.privilege: Can only download torrents older than 7 days. Cannot upload. Any Hit & Runs disable downloading until cleared.

levels.name: Newbie
levels.privilege: Newly registered users. Can only download torrents older than 7 days. Cannot use RSS or upload torrents.

levels.name: Member
levels.privilege: Registered users in good standing with 5 GB+ upload and a ratio of 1.0 or above.

levels.name: Power User
levels.privilege: Experienced members with strong upload history and consistently good ratio.

levels.name: VIP
levels.privilege: Distinguished member, donator, or retired staff.

levels.name: Uploader
levels.privilege: Promoted by staff for quality and quantity of uploads. Access to the upload API and tag creation.

levels.name: Editor
levels.privilege: Promoted by staff. Can create and edit anime database entries.

levels.name: Staff
levels.privilege: Site assistant with access to the admin panel and moderation tools.

levels.name: Moderator
levels.privilege: Moderates the site and its users.
